descriptionText:
Topps baseball 3-card lot.

1) Ronald Acuna Jr. - Atlanta Braves - Topps Stadium Club Special Forces #SF-18 (foil insert)
2) Juan Soto - New York Mets - 2025 All Topps Team #ATT-7 (gold design insert)
3) Byron Buxton - Minnesota Twins - Topps Stars of MLB #SMLB-22 (foil insert)

Three inserts, no base cards. Ungraded, near mint or better. Every card is pictured front and back.

You will receive the exact three cards pictured. Shipped in sleeves and a toploader, protected.
